title: pulqui~
description: `pulqui~` delays an input signal and generates a delayed scanned “side-chain” signal for manipulating the original signal with `pulquilimiter~` or another process. It automatically chooses the smallest latency above 25 ms that is a multiple of the patch block size, while an optional power-of-two buffer argument selects a fixed starting size; `info` prints the latency to the console.
